label: ivr
scenario: Library renewal phone tree: card and PIN via DTMF, lists items, renews two and reads back new due dates, reports one item blocked by a hold.
task: Renew the customer's library books that are due September 15th.

outcome.confirmation_artifact: new due date October 6th read back for two items

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Welcome to the Fairhaven Public Library automated renewal line. Please enter your fourteen-digit library card number now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You have three items checked out. To hear your items, press 1. To renew all items, press 2. To return to the main menu, press star.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Item 1. The Salt Road. Due September 15th. Item 2. A Field Guide to Eastern Mushrooms. Due September 15th. Item 3. Clockwork Harbor. Due September 22nd. To renew all items, press 2. To renew a single item, press 3.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait while we process your request.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two items were renewed. The Salt Road is now due October 6th. A Field Guide to Eastern Mushrooms is now due October 6th. One item could not be renewed. Clockwork Harbor has a hold placed by another patron. To hear this information again, press 1. To end this call, press 9.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Fairhaven Public Library. Goodbye.
